'''Bo Zarran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3638 BBY]] he took part in a large [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] gathering on [[Darvannis]] along with his trained [[Reek/Legends|Reek]] [[Thrasher (reek)|Thrasher]]. When a strike team attacked the gathering, Bo Zarran and Thrasher engaged them in combat, but were both killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bo Zarran appears in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' during the "Scum and Villainy" operation.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
